dedupe_keys.name: inami riziv statistics belgium yearly tables of individual health care providers by profession age practice status and density plus reimbursement and medicines statistics 2013 to 2025

description: These are the official statistics of Belgium's national health insurance institute, INAMI-RIZIV, on the health care workforce and on insurance spending. For each year from 2013 to 2025 a page publishes PDF tables of individual care providers for each profession, counted by age group, by whether they are in practice or in training, and as a density per 10,000 inhabitants, with trends from 2015 to 2024; the tables show, for example, 39,951 practising physicians in 2024. Further pages give reimbursed amounts, medicine use and numbers of insured people. The tables are free and available to download from the INAMI-RIZIV site in French and Dutch; no licence terms are stated. Caveats: the provider counts are national and regional aggregates, not a facility list, the tables are PDF, and counts depend on INAMI registration rules. Simulation uses: sizing the medical workforce available for surge capacity, modelling the effect of staff shortages on service continuity and projecting ageing of the workforce. Related records: the WHO health infrastructure indicators (data-who-gho-health-infrastructure-indicators) give international comparisons, and GISCO healthcare services (data-gisco-healthcare-services-europe) map Belgian hospitals.
